parts.text: Motivation is the reason you're not making progress.
You wait to feel ready. You wait for the right mood. You wait for Monday.
And while you wait, nothing happens.
Here's the truth: motivation is a feeling, and feelings come and go.
Disciplined people don't feel like it either. They just don't ask their feelings for permission.
So stop waiting. Start with two minutes. Put your shoes on. Open the book. Write one line.
Action creates motivation. Not the other way around.
Don't wait to feel it. Start, and you will.
